papers.title: Effect of Hydroxyapatite Formation on Titanium Surface with Bone Morphogenetic Protein-2 Loading through Electrochemical Deposition on MG-63 Cells.
papers.abstract: Calcium phosphate ceramics used in dentistry and orthopedics are some of the most valuable biomaterials, owing to their excellent osteoconduction, osteoinduction, and osseointegration. Osteoconduction and osteoinduction are critical targets for bone regeneration, and osseointegration is essential for any dental implantations. In this study, a hydroxyapatite (HAp) hybrid coating layer with the sequential release of bone morphogenetic protein 2 (BMP-2) was deposited onto an etched titanium substrate by electrochemical deposition. The resulting release of BMP-2 from Ti⁻HAp was assessed by immersing samples in a simulated buffer fluid solution. Through coculture, human osteosarcoma cell proliferation and alkaline phosphatase activity were assessed. The characteristics and effect on cell proliferation of the hybrid coatings were investigated for their functionality through X-ray diffraction (XRD) and cell proliferation assays. Findings revealed that -0.8 V vs. Ag/AgCl (3 M KCl) exhibited the optimal HAp properties and a successfully coated HAp layer. XRD confirmed the crystallinity of the deposited HAp on the titanium surface. Ti-0.8 V Ti⁻HAp co-coating BMP sample exhibited the highest cell proliferation efficiency and was more favorable for cell growth. A successful biocompatible hybrid coating with optimized redox voltage enhanced the osseointegration process. The findings suggest that this technique could have promising clinical applications to enhance the healing times and success rates of dental implantation.

llm.relevance_to_user: 该论文涉及钛表面涂层和细胞响应，未涉及增材制造、多孔结构或力学性能，与用户研究方向不相关。
llm.why_not_core: No additive manufacturing (LPBF), no porous structure design, no mechanical testing (fatigue or static), no stress shielding analysis, and no as-built surface morphology characterization.

summary_zh.motivation: 通过混合涂层增强钛表面的骨整合能力。
summary_zh.method: 采用电化学沉积法在钛表面制备含BMP-2的羟基磷灰石涂层。
summary_zh.result: -0.8 V电压下涂层性能最优，且负载BMP-2后细胞增殖效率最高。
summary_zh.validation: 通过XRD和MG-63细胞增殖实验验证涂层效果。

summary_en.motivation: To enhance osseointegration of titanium implants by developing a hybrid coating with sustained BMP-2 release.
summary_en.method: A hydroxyapatite coating with bone morphogenetic protein-2 was deposited on etched titanium via electrochemical deposition at varying voltages.
summary_en.result: The -0.8 V condition produced optimal HAp crystallinity and the Ti-HAp-BMP-2 sample showed the highest MG-63 cell proliferation.
summary_en.validation: In vitro cell assays (MG-63 proliferation and ALP activity) and XRD crystallinity analysis were performed.
